classification_key: objects, logical models and payload shapes

rules.must: match all semantically relevant surfaces to one or more declared classes

rules.when: one deployment exposes materially different capability surfaces
rules.must: classify each surface independently and preserve field/object authority
rules.otherwise: do not create a vendor-shaped mega-class

rules.must: select only an adapter whose conformance receipts satisfy every requested operation and assurance requirement
rules.otherwise: refuse selection even if source_class_id matches

rules.when: a plan depends on rate, quota, page, payload, concurrency, retention, cursor TTL, timeout, cost, egress or license
rules.otherwise: emit an unprobed-limit gap; never copy a class default

rules.when: a source class permits write or command
rules.must: keep write disabled unless an explicit separately authorized control-plane contract and destructive-guard receipt exist

rules.when: snapshot and incremental acquisition are composed
rules.must: require a verified common cut, resume token and reconciliation
rules.otherwise: mark the plan incapable of lossless capture

rules.when: authority, deletion, order, finality, time or schema meaning is unresolved
rules.must: preserve raw evidence and emit a semantic gap
rules.otherwise: never guess from a field or product name

outputs: read/change plan with cut and reconciliation
llm_quarantine: Generic model registries, artifacts and serving telemetry may be source occurrences; LLM, prompt, RAG and agent-memory semantics remain outside the core namespace and cannot alter core dispatch laws.
